# Packages


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(MatchIt)
```

# Data


```{r}
data("lalonde", package = "MatchIt")
glimpse(lalonde)
```

# Visualize

```{r}
# add code here
```


# Naive estimate

```{r}
naive <- linear_reg() |>
  fit(re78 ~ treat, lalonde)

tidy(naive)
```


# Regression adjustment

```{r}
reg <- linear_reg() |>
  fit(re78 ~ treat + age + educ + re74 + re75, lalonde)

tidy(reg)
```


# Alternative: nearest-neighbor matching

```{r}
m_out <- matchit(
  treat ~ age + educ + re74 + re75,
  data   = lalonde,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "mahalanobis"
)

m_data <- match.data(m_out)

linear_reg() |>
  fit(re78 ~ treat, data = m_data) |>
  tidy()
```

# Alternative: propensity score matching

```{r}
ps_match <- matchit(
  treat ~ age + educ + re74 + re75,
  data     = lalonde,
  method   = "nearest",
  distance = "glm"
)

summary(ps_match, un = FALSE)

ps_data <- match.data(ps_match)

linear_reg() |>
  fit(re78 ~ treat, data = ps_data) |>
  tidy()
```
